hypothesis: The causal near-to-far ATM implied-vol term slope (term_slope) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return kurtosis (fourth standardized moment, tail fatness) of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the EVAL-74 term floor.
extends: EVAL-74/96/104/113 (same term_slope signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-85/109/111/112 (same forward-window convention, fourth moment instead of third); distinct cell: single-asset term_slope -> forward realized return kurtosis

protocol.title: Options near-to-far ATM implied-vol term slope (term_slope) -> forward own-asset realized return kurtosis predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74/96/104/113 (same term_slope signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-85/109/111/112 (same forward-window convention, fourth moment instead of third); distinct cell: single-asset term_slope -> forward realized return kurtosis
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74/84/96/99/104/113; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-to-far ATM IV term slope (e74._term_bars term_slope), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return kurtosis = m4 / m2**2 over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); fourth standardized moment (tail fatness)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_slope_z_k, kurt_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher term slope -> fatter forward return tails)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
